name: io.github.aniruddhaadak80/griha
description: Griha — a shared household chore ledger with a deterministic fairness engine, a SHA-384 sealed audit chain, and the same service layer behind the web UI and the MCP tools.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Hosted Postgres connection string. In production Griha refuses to boot without it rather than falling back to an embedded database that would lose every household on the next cold start.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_SCHEMA
environmentVariables.description: Optional Postgres schema to namespace tables in when sharing one database with another application. Defaults to public.

headers.name: x-griha-token
headers.description: The household board token from https://griha.vercel.app/settings. Required because an MCP client is an external program with no browser session to inherit; it must present an explicit credential. The read-only share token also works, but grants reads only.
